Promotional and commercial purposes

The Department of Enhancement and Economic Strategies deals with concessions and authorisations for the use of images for promotional and commercial purposes, pursuant to Articles 107-108 of Legislative Decree 42/2004 and ss.mm.ii. and Ministerial Decree 108 of 21 March 2024 ‘Guidelines for the determination of the minimum amounts of fees and considerations for the concession of use of the assets handed over to the institutes and cultural places of the Ministry of Culture’, amending Ministerial Decree 161 of 11 April 2023.
Applicants may submit requests to ga-uff.permessi@cultura.gov.it.
